Position Overview 

At Autodesk, we are pioneers in 3D design, engineering, and entertainment software, building tools that empower some of the most creative minds on the planet to solve real-world problems. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Glassdoor, and others as a top place to work, we are dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where innovation and creativity thrive. 

Autodesk's Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) Data organization is seeking an experienced Software Architect to join the AEC Data team and define the cloud-native services and distributed-systems architecture that power the AEC Data Model (AECDM) and the many services around it. 

Data is the domain, but the role is fundamentally one of cloud and services architecture — APIs, service contracts, integrations, distributed-systems design, and the connected data model that ties them together — spanning multiple teams. It is not a data-warehouse or analytics-specialist role. 

The AEC Data organization is building the foundational data infrastructure behind Autodesk's vision for connected construction: the platforms, services, and unified data models that span the entire built-asset lifecycle, from design and construction through operation and maintenance. This work enables the continuous flow of AEC data (3D models, 2D drawings, issue tracking, cost, sensor streams, and more) across Autodesk products and third-party integrations. The architect will help shape the next generation of capabilities for the Autodesk Forma Industry Cloud, collaborating with software architects, domain experts, and product teams across Revit, Civil 3D, AutoCAD, Autodesk Construction Cloud, and Autodesk Forma. 

This is a senior individual-contributor role on an established architecture track, reporting to the Distinguished Architect of the AEC Data team, who also serves as the Lead Software Architect. The primary responsibility is to shape how multiple teams design and build — through standards, reference architectures, ADRs, and design-review governance — rather than to own a single service. The exact focus flexes to your strengths and organizational need. 

Responsibilities 

  • API Design & Evolution: Design and evolve API surfaces across the AEC Data services — resource modeling, addressing, versioning and backward-compatible evolution, query APIs, and unifying overlapping surfaces into a single coherent contract. 

  • System Architecture: Define and evolve cross-team, cloud-native architecture across the AEC Data services; design distributed systems including service contracts and event-driven flows. 

  • Schema Design & Evolution: Design, document, and evolve data schemas for AEC domain entities (buildings, infrastructure, spaces, systems, components, relationships) — including semantic models, property sets, classification systems, and relationship hierarchies. Own versioning, backward/forward compatibility, deprecation, and migration; maintain the schema registry, validation rules, and quality checks. 

  • Standards & Governance: Establish standards, reference architectures, and reusable components; author architecture proposals and decision records (ADRs) for review by a cross-org architecture council, and run cross-team design reviews. 

  • Prototyping & Feasibility: Evaluate alternative architectural directions through modeling and prototyping, de-risking key decisions before broad adoption. 

  • Mentorship & Technical Leadership: Mentor engineers and fellow architects on emerging and established technologies and on architectural practice; grow technical depth across teams. 

  • Reliability & Performance: Ensure reliability, security, and performance of systems; define SLOs and drive observability (metrics, tracing, logging). 

  • Communication: Communicate architecture with clear views and diagrams (e.g., C4) and executive-ready narratives; produce comprehensive documentation and onboarding materials. 

Minimum Qualifications 

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or equivalent experience. 

  • 10+ years designing cloud-native, distributed systems, including 5+ years at cross-team architect altitude (Software Architect, Principal Engineer, Staff+, or equivalent). Title is flexible; scope of impact is the primary consideration. 

  • Deep expertise in cloud services (ideally AWS), API/service design, and distributed-systems patterns (microservices, event-driven, resilience). 

  • Solid grounding in data modeling and schema design — including schema definition languages (e.g., JSON Schema), versioning, and backward/forward-compatibility and evolution strategies — as applied both to standalone data schemas and to API contracts. Specialist data-warehouse or analytics architecture is not required. 

  • Excellent knowledge of software design and architecture patterns. 

  • Demonstrated ability to influence without authority and drive alignment across teams outside the candidate's direct management. 

  • Strong leadership and mentoring skills, with a track record of guiding and growing diverse, cross-functional teams. 

  • Mastery of conveying complex ideas concisely and persuasively, with excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills across a range of stakeholders. 

  • Ability to collaborate with a global team. 

Preferred Qualifications 

Preferred qualifications are a menu rather than a checklist: depth in a few core areas matters more than breadth across all of them. The emerging AI/ML capabilities below are advantageous and can be developed on the job; they are not prerequisites. 

Core: 

  • Cloud Services: AWS and its core services (EC2, ECS, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, RDS). 

  • Distributed Systems: Domain-driven service decomposition, data consistency patterns (CQRS, event sourcing, sagas), and multi-tenant/multi-region design. 

  • API & Service Design: REST API design and evolution; GraphQL (including federation). 

  • Database Architecture: Relational and NoSQL (e.g., DynamoDB, PostgreSQL). 

  • Observability/SRE: OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, metrics/SLOs for data services. 

Bonus: 

  • Semantic Technologies: Knowledge graphs, RDF/OWL, or property graphs — particularly relevant to the connected/semantic AECDM. 

  • BIM Expertise: Building Information Modeling concepts, Revit families, or similar parametric modeling systems. 

  • AI Systems: RAG, agents/MCP, agentic orchestration (LangGraph, Semantic Kernel), LLM observability, and data governance / AI safety (PII, prompt-injection, content filtering). 

  • Domain-Specific AI for AEC: BIM/IFC extraction, CAD or point-cloud processing. 

  • Event-Driven Architectures: Kafka or Kinesis; schema registries (Confluent, AWS Glue); exactly-once processing. 

  • AEC Domain Knowledge: Experience in the Architecture, Engineering, and Construction industry; familiarity with industry standards (IFC, COBie, gbXML, CityGML, LandXML, UniFormat, OmniClass). Domain onboarding is provided. 

About the Team 

The AEC Data team is building the AEC Data Model (AECDM) to enable better AECO (Architecture, Engineering, Construction, Operations) outcomes through more useful, connected, and accessible data. Its scope spans data services and APIs, product and design-tool integrations, and lifecycle/asset data across multiple teams — enabling the seamless flow of information across Autodesk products and third-party integrations so that AEC professionals can make better decisions with better data. 

Why Join Us 

  • Shape the future of AEC data platforms and standards at an industry-leading company. 

  • Design systems and schemas used by millions of architects, engineers, and construction professionals worldwide. 

  • Collaborate with world-class software architects and engineers across Autodesk's AEC portfolio.

About This Role

We're hiring the first Bookkeepers on our Financial Management team — a founding, hands-on role at the intersection of real client bookkeeping and 0-to-1 product building. You won't be joining an established practice with a mature playbook; you'll be writing it. You'll do the actual books for our earliest restaurant customers while working shoulder-to-shoulder with product and engineering to shape the service, tooling, and workflows that will define how Toast delivers bookkeeping at scale.

This role is for someone who genuinely likes restaurant bookkeeping — the prime cost, the tip reporting, the multi-location chaos — and who also gets energy from questioning industry norms and building something new rather than maintaining something established. Ambiguity here isn't a bug; for the first year or two, it's the job.

If you're the kind of person who reads a messy set of restaurant books and sees an interesting puzzle — and who'd rather build the recipe than follow one — we'd love to hear from you.

A day in the life (Responsibilities)

  • Own end-to-end bookkeeping for a portfolio of pilot restaurant customers: chart of accounts setup, monthly close, bank/POS reconciliations, accruals, and delivery of clean financial statements.
  • Serve as Toast's in-house expert on restaurant-specific accounting — prime cost, COGS, labor and tip reporting, multi-unit consolidation, high-volume daily transaction reconciliation, and multi-jurisdiction sales tax.
  • Embed directly with product and engineering, translating real client workflows and pain points into product requirements that shape our roadmap — you'll be in the room when we decide what to build next, not just told what shipped.
  • Design and document the SOPs, controls, and QA processes a bookkeeping function needs to run reliably — since none of it exists yet, you'll build the foundation others will scale on.
  • Work directly with restaurant operators to understand their businesses, set expectations, and deliver a service that earns their trust.
  • Help define what “great” looks like for this function as it grows, including future hiring needs, tooling choices, and where automation should (and shouldn't) replace judgment.
  • Move fluidly between hands-on bookkeeping work and higher-leverage building work as priorities shift — comfort wearing both hats is essential.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • 5+years of bookkeeping experience, with meaningful time spent on restaurant or hospitality clients specifically.
  • Deep working knowledge of restaurant accounting mechanics: COGS and prime cost, tip pooling and reporting, multi-location consolidation, and reconciling high-volume POS transaction data.

About the Role

The RevTech Senior Salesforce Developer is the embedded technical partner for their GTM squad (Client Success, Sales & Marketing, or Launch Ops), owning the full arc from ambiguous business problem to designed, documented, and shipped technical solution. You'll operate with significant autonomy as your squad's de facto strategic technical partner, while a platform Technical Lead sets shared standards across squads. Increasingly, that technical partnership includes engineering as we build UI engagement layers for our GTM teams that live inside a common React/NestJS platform rather than inside Salesforce itself.

What You'll Do

  • Act as the primary technical partner for your assigned squad, building trust with non-technical stakeholders, understanding their workflows deeply enough to anticipate needs.
  • Translate ambiguous business requirements into clear solution designs, build and test what you design, iterate with the business based on their feedback, and deploy your own work to production, collaborating with your fellow developers and the platform Technical Lead so your changes align with shared standards and don't conflict with what's happening elsewhere on the platform.
  • Partner with Engineering on internal GTM tools, custom applications that sit on top of Salesforce data, built on a shared React (Vite/TypeScript/Tailwind/Apollo Client) frontend and NestJS/GraphQL backend, exposing and syncing Salesforce data through secure services and APIs, and building Lightning Web Components only for the narrower set of cases that still call for native Salesforce UI extension
  • Collaborate with AI Automation Engineers, who build and own automations and integrations in n8n, providing the Salesforce expertise and access they need to connect those workflows to your squad's data and processes.

  • Determine the right tool for the job. Flow and declarative configuration when it fits, Apex and custom code when the problem demands it, and be equally comfortable executing either
  • Write and maintain secure, well-tested Apex classes, triggers, batch jobs, and asynchronous processes for business-critical workflows, adhering to Salesforce security best practices and maintaining meaningful test coverage
  • Participate in code review, maintain documentation, and ensure changes are deployed through structured release processes (sandboxes → production)
  • Use AI tooling to accelerate development, generating Apex, debugging logic, scaffolding LWCs, validating test coverage, and reading, updating, and maintaining Salesforce metadata and configurations

  • Comfort operating as the sole embedded technical resource for a business function, with real autonomy and real accountability
  • Demonstrated ability to run a discovery conversation with a non-technical stakeholder and come back with a clear solution design and documentation, not just working code
  • Ability to read a business process, ask the right clarifying questions, and turn ambiguity into a working technical solution
  • 5+ years of Salesforce development experience with a demonstrable track record of writing Apex and building LWCs in production environments
  • Proficiency in Apex (classes, triggers, batch/queueable/schedulable), SOQL/SOSL, and the Salesforce security model
  • Comfortable building Lightning Web Components when a use case calls for native Salesforce UI, though most of our current engagement layer work happens outside Salesforce in custom applications built with Engineering, so experience exposing Salesforce data through secure services/APIs is just as relevant
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining integrations with external systems
  • Comfort using AI tooling as part of your daily development workflow; able to prompt effectively, validate AI-generated code critically, and ship it confidently
  • Working knowledge of Salesforce DevOps tooling. We use GitHub and Gearset

What Sets the Best Candidates Apart

  • Familiarity with B2B SaaS Revenue Life Cycle Management, CPQ tools, Salesforce Flow at scale, and Omni Channel.
  • Track record of owning a complex, custom-built Salesforce solution, not just contributing to one
  • Experience administering third-party GTM tools beyond Salesforce. This role goes beyond supporting just Salesforce and includes our entire GTM tech stack.
  • Exposure to the modern web stack our internal tools run on, including React (Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind, React Router, Apollo Client), NestJS/GraphQL, Postgres, and Redis for background jobs, enough to be a productive partner to Engineering on these tools, rather than needing everything handed off

What This Role Is Not

This is not a configurator or admin-only role. We build declarative-first when the use case supports it, but this role requires a developer who knows when to configure and when to write code, and who is fully comfortable doing both.

This is also not a single-cloud, single-system role. You'll support Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Experience Cloud, not just one, and your scope extends beyond Salesforce entirely, into our third-party GTM tools and the internal applications we build in partnership with Engineering. This isn't a Salesforce developer role in the traditional sense; it's a technical ownership role across the whole GTM tech stack.

This also isn't a purely heads-down engineering role. You're expected to be a visible, trusted partner to your squad, attending weekly meetings with your stakeholders. You will not be a ticket taker, we expect you to be a dedicated technical strategic partner working in collaboration with your business function, RevTech team, Engineering, and AI Automation Engineers. You will not be working in a silo.

We are tech industry veterans in software, hardware, and design who are pooling our skills to build the future we want to live in. We are solving real-world problems leveraging robotics, machine learning and computer vision, among other disciplines, with a mindful eye towards the end-to-end user experience. The Data Analyst drives data management workflows and performs data analysis. This role connects our internal systems with various logistics partners, builds data pipelines, calculates metrics, and creates dashboards & alerts to highlight operational bottlenecks. This position leverages AI tools and frameworks to build faster, create scalable API connections, and manage the data architecture that keeps Serve’s supply chain running.

  • Develop and manage API-based workflows to ensure seamless communication between our core business platforms and external logistics partners.

  • Design, build, and maintain automated pipelines to retrieve and route data across various internal and external databases and tools.

  • Perform hands-on data analysis (e.g., tracking average shipping times, inventory flows, etc.) and build automated spreadsheets and/or dashboards for stakeholders.

  • Implement error handling, alerting, etc. to ensure data workflows run consistently and accurately.

  • Partner with Supply Chain, Operations, Finance, and Engineering stakeholders to define KPIs, reporting requirements, and data quality standards across supply chain processes.

  • Conduct root cause analysis on operational issues and recommend process improvements that reduce cost, improve inventory accuracy, and increase logistics performance.

  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills, with the ability to translate complex data into actionable business recommendations for nontechnical stakeholders.

  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage multiple projects, prioritize competing requests, and deliver high quality work in a fast paced environment.

Preferred Experience, Qualifications, and Skills

  • Google Cloud Platform (GCP): Specifically Cloud Run, BigQuery, and other supporting services.

  • Google Workspace / G Suite: Specifically Google Sheets and Google Apps Script.

  • NetSuite: Specifically working with the NetSuite API.

  • Supply Chain Tech Experience: Applying these data and technology skills specifically within supply chain, logistics, or e-commerce operations.

  • Experience working with third party logistics (3PL), fulfillment, inventory management, or transportation management systems.

  • Familiarity with data observability, monitoring, and data quality frameworks in production environments.
